title: What to do tomorrow?
english_paragraphs: A: What do you want to do tomorrow?
B: Yes, I forgot. I want to sleep at home tomorrow morning, and I want to go to the bookstore to buy books in the afternoon. What about you?
A: I want to go shopping.
B: What do you want to buy?
A: I want to buy a cup, a carton of milk, and some fruit.
B: What fruit do you like to eat?
A: I like to eat bananas and apples.
B: There is no more fruit at my house. The apples are very good now. Please help me buy a pound.
A: No problem. What time should I give you the apple tomorrow?
B: I will go home from the bookstore at five o'clock tomorrow. You can come to my house at five o'clock. You can also have dinner at my house and we can cook it ourselves tomorrow, how about that?
A: OK, I will go to your house at five o'clock tomorrow.
english_full:
A: What do you want to do tomorrow?

B: Go to school tomorrow.

A: Tomorrow is Saturday, off.

B: Yes, I forgot. I want to sleep at home tomorrow morning, and I want to go to the bookstore to buy books in the afternoon. What about you?

A: I want to go shopping.

B: What do you want to buy?

A: I want to buy a cup, a carton of milk, and some fruit.

B: What fruit do you like to eat?

A: I like to eat bananas and apples.

B: There is no more fruit at my house. The apples are very good now. Please help me buy a pound.

A: No problem. What time should I give you the apple tomorrow?

B: I will go home from the bookstore at five o'clock tomorrow. You can come to my house at five o'clock. You can also have dinner at my house and we can cook it ourselves tomorrow, how about that?

A: OK, I will go to your house at five o'clock tomorrow.
russian_paragraphs: A: Что́ вы хочете сделать за́втра?
B: Я пойду в шко́лу за́втра.
B: Да, я забыл. Я хочу́ спать до́ма за́втра у́тром, а днём хочу́ пойти в кни́жный магази́н, чтобы купи́ть кни́ги. А вы что́?
A: Я хочу́ купить ча́шку, коро́бку молоко́ и не́сколько фру́ктов.
B: Какие фру́кты вы любите есть?
A: Я люблю́ есть бана́ны и я́блоки.
B: У меня́ до́ма не́т больше фру́ктов. Я́блоки сéйчас са́мые хоро́шие. Помоги́те мне купи́ть па́унд.
A: Не́ за что. Во сколькo я должен дать вам я́блоко за́втра?
B: Я пойду́ до́ма из кни́жного магази́на в пять часо́в за́втра. Вы можете прийти ко мне́ до́ма в пять часо́в. Вы таќже можете поужи́нать у меня́ и мы будем гото́вить его са́ми за́втра, что́ скажете?
A: Ла́дно, я прийду́ к вам до́ма в пять часо́в за́втра.
reading_paragraphs: A: Chtó vy khótite sdelát' závtra?
B: Ya poydú v shkólu závtra.
B: Da, ya zabýl. Ya khóchu spat' dóma závtra útrom, a dnyóm khóchu poyti v knízhnyy magazíin, chtoby kupít' knígi. A vy chtó?
A: Ya khóchu kupit' cháshku, koróbbku molokó i néskol'ko frúktov.
B: Kakie frúkty vy lyubíte yest'?
A: Ya lyublyú yest' banány i yáblochi.
B: U menyá dóma nét bol'she frúktov. Yáblochi séychas sámye khóroshie. Pomogíte mne kupit' páund.
A: Né za chto. Vo skol'ko ya dolzhen dat' vam yábloko závtra?

B: Ya poydú dóma iz knízhnyy magazíin v pyat' chasóv závtra. Vy mozhete priyti ko mné dóma v pyat' chasóv. Vy taḱzhe mozhete póuzhinat' u menyá i my budem gotovít' ego sámi závtra, chtó skazhete?
A: Ládno, ya priydú k vam dóma v pyat' chasóv závtra.
